body:
Build an unattended path from official Repo2RLEnv PR candidates to reproducible, independently controlled task bundles, preserving original grading without per-task human/LLM repairs.

**Current:** [PR #46](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/46) provides the reusable validation component, open/unmerged with 41 offline tests and both GitHub checks passing. Existing native comparisons reproduced the unchanged positive/clean Cobrapy reference and Scanpy’s prerequisite failure, with verified archival/cleanup. Main still exposes prompt inspection pending review.

**Fresh generation:** #45 now exercised official generation → audited local export → ordinary validation automatically. One fresh package for already known Cobrapy PR #1497 cost **$0.287646 across 11 upstream model calls**. The unchanged clean rebuild failed before controls because its saved APT install follows a prelude that deletes package indexes. Both primary archives have anonymous HF readback; both owned cleanup proofs are verified empty and completed recovery is inert. No task/grade repair or regeneration. [Findings](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7759bb06/experiments/45-generation-handoff/results.md). A freshly generated portable task with independent passing controls remains unproven; general recipe fidelity is [#47](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/47), now testing the explicit generic package-index candidate on the same reserved worker. Live reports show clean builds completed and original controls started; sealed outcomes/archival/cleanup remain pending.

**Coverage:** original #28 totals remain 83 exports, 82 ever-positive and 67 ever-clean. Twenty-five exports are publicly eligible; 58 Matchms exports remain withheld. The fresh #1497 reproduction is a separate package instance of a known PR, not an additional unique task. Keep follow-up controls and historical totals separate.

**Budget:** reconciled allocation 8.785054/32 CPUh, with 6.333333 CPUh reserved for the one candidate including stop/cleanup. Provider actual $0.287646; existing $10 archival reservation unreconciled. No active model reservation/admission or new paid capacity. Operating ceiling $90, strictly below $100 extra. [Ledger and next-step scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/bf55b626/experiments/33-unattended-validation/next-step.json).

Keep #28 closed and this epic/children open for review. Concise status lives here; detailed logs, append-only HF receipts and follow-ups live in comments/subissues. Retain protected evidence and research branches. No automatic PR merge or dataset release.
